title: Random Quadratic Form with random forcing: Metastable synchronization by noise
abstract: arXiv:2608.16664v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study the Random Quadratic Form (RQF) on a sphere in the presence of random Brownian forcing. We show that the forcing does not effectively change the law of the process but affects the synchronization properties of the system. While the RQF without forcing exhibits partial synchronization due to the intrinsic symmetries, the introduction of an arbitrarily small forcing results in long-term symmetry breaking and leads to full synchronization.   In this work we focus on the small forcing regime and recover the multiscale behavior of the two-point process. We show that in the first stage the model converges to an anti-polar configuration due to the symmetries of the RQF and in the second stage the two clusters meet due to the symmetry breaking phenomenon. translated_title: 随机二次型与随机强迫：噪声引起的亚稳态同步
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在随机布朗强迫作用下球面上的随机二次型（RQF）。我们表明，强迫并不有效改变过程的规律，但会影响系统的同步特性。虽然无强迫的RQF由于内在对称性表现出部分同步，但引入任意小的强迫会导致长期对称性破缺，并引发完全同步。在这项工作中，我们关注小强迫区域，并恢复了两点过程的多尺度行为。我们表明，在第一阶段，由于RQF的对称性，模型收敛到反极性配置，而在第二阶段，由于对称性破缺现象，两个簇相遇。该模型受连续时间机器学习模型（如神经常微分方程和连续时间变换器）的启发。特别是，这项工作的结果揭示了...
tldr: 该研究揭示了在随机布朗强迫下，随机二次型系统通过对称性破缺实现从部分同步到完全同步的转变，并展示了多尺度动力学行为，为连续时间机器学习模型提供了理论见解。
en_tdlr: This study reveals that under random Brownian forcing, the random quadratic form system transitions from partial to full synchronization via symmetry breaking, exhibiting multiscale dynamics and offering theoretical insights for continuous-time machine learning models.
